snippet.title: The Pizza Tower Soundtrack Comes to Trombone Champ!
snippet.description:
This DLC song pack brings 14 songs from the Pizza Tower Original Soundtrack to Trombone Champ!

Warning: A lot of these tracks are extremely challenging! This DLC is intended for players with Trombone Champ experience! Do you have what it takes to conquer the Tower of Pizza?...

Grab the DLC here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4140920/Trombone_Champ_Pizza_Tower_Song_Pack/

PIZZA TOWER TRACK LIST:

- Pizza Deluxe - Post Elvis
- Put On A Show! - ClascyJitto
- It's Pizza Time! - Mr. Sauceman
- Funiculi Holiday - ClascyJitto
- Extraterrestrial Wahwahs - Mr. Sauceman
- Oregano Mirage - ClascyJitto
- Good Eatin' - ClascyJitto
- Cold Spaghetti - Mr. Sauceman
- Yeehaw Deliveryboy - ClascyJitto
- Pumpin' Hot Stuff - Mr. Sauceman
- What's On The Kid's Menu? - ClascyJitto
- The Death That I Deservioli - Mr. Sauceman
- Unexpectancy (Part 2 of 3) - Mr. Sauceman
- Bye Bye There! - Mr. Sauceman
